text:
olivia: Hey all — first week on runtime. Trying to build from source on my dev laptop (Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 5.19). Followed the README but `make` fails when loading the nvidia kernel module: `nvidia-drm: failed to load, -ENODEV` and dkms shows missing symbols. Driver reported as 535.86, CUDA 12.1. Any quick checks I should run?

ben: welcome! usual suspects: kernel headers mismatch or secure boot. Run `uname -r` and `ls /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build` to confirm headers. Also `sudo dkms autoinstall` after installing headers.

olivia: ran `uname -r` -> `5.19.0-46-generic`. `ls` on build returns "No such file or directory". I did `sudo apt-get install linux-headers-$(uname -r)` but still same.

maria: if `linux-headers-$(uname -r)` didn't install, check apt sources — sometimes HWE kernels need different package names. Also check `dpkg -l | grep headers` to see what's installed.

samir: also check Secure Boot — kernel will refuse unsigned modules. `mokutil --sb-state` will tell you. If it's enabled, either disable secure boot in BIOS or sign the module (we have a small script in onboarding).

olivia: output: `mokutil --sb-state` -> "SecureBoot enabled". OK that explains the module drop. What's the signing flow?

ben: easiest for devbox is disable secure boot unless you need it. If you prefer signing, see `scripts/sign-module.sh` in repo — it walks through generating a MOK key and enrolling it. After signing, do `sudo update-initramfs -u` and reboot.

infra-bot: onboarding-gpu-image: https://intra.redwood/dev-onboard/gpu-setup — has signing script and recommended package list (driver 535.98 + CUDA 12.2).

olivia: thanks, I'll try disabling Secure Boot for now. One more thing: the build logs showed a bunch of `undefined symbol: nv_kernctl_*` errors in DKMS patch step. Is that a driver/CUDA mismatch?

maria: those undefined symbols usually mean the kernel driver version doesn't match the user-space toolkit. Upgrading the driver to the distro-provided one or matching the CUDA toolkit to the driver can fix it. We standardize on driver 535.98 with CUDA 12.2 for local dev images.

samir: if you want, I can provision a pre-baked dev VM (same image infra uses) so you avoid local setup pains. Ping me and I'll spin one up for your onboarding.

olivia: appreciate it — trying the Secure Boot change first, but I'll take the VM if it still blocks me. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
